lex:
ἁπλοῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν
(contr. fr. -όος; ἁ.- cop., πλόος), [in LXX: Pro.11:25 * ;]
simple, single: in a moral sense (DCG, ii, 628 f.), ἀφθαλμός, Mat.6:22, Luk.11:34. (In π. of a marriage dowry, see MM, see word).†
ἁπλόος, see: ἁπλοῦς
SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἀκέραιος (Tr., Syn., § lvi; Cremer, 107, 639)

strongs.def: properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear)
strongs.from: probably from G1 (Α) (as a particle of union) and the base of G4120 (πλέκω)
